name: TRY DRY: The Dry January app
description:
Try Dry® is the powerful, easy-to-use, and totally free premium app helping tens of thousands of people to take control of their drinking. Try Dry® is the official app of the Dry January® challenge, which was created and is run by the charity Alcohol Change UK.

Co-created with drinkers and based on behavioural science and a spirit of experimenting (hence the name), Try Dry® contains unique features such as 'planned drinking', custom goals, and special missions. Unlike 'sobriety-only apps', it works brilliantly whether you want to cut back or try being sober.

Whether you’re taking on the Dry January® challenge, doing Sober Spring, trying a sober October, making a longer-term change to your drinking, or just cutting back, the Try Dry® app is your trusted year-round support system.

Why should I download Try Dry®?
•	Track your units, calories and money saved
•	Set goals that work for you
•	Loads of great badges to achieve with in-app celebrations
•	Access our exclusive free coaching email programme
•	See your progress using the charts
•      Daily motivation - receive a reminder every day, at a time that suits you
•      Use the drinking risk quiz to see how you are doing
•      Led by science, developed for you. Try Dry® combines behavioural science with a highly responsive approach to feedback from users. 
•      Totally free. No upfront costs. No hidden costs. No ads. Entirely funded by the charity Alcohol Change UK.

Why cut down your drinking?
•	Better sleep. More energy.

name: Useless - Screen Time Control
description:
Your friends are better than any app blocker.

4+ hours a day. That's what the average person hands their phone.

useLess helps you take it back. Set rules for the apps that distract you, like a daily time limit or a focus schedule. When a rule kicks in, the app blocks. The catch that makes it work: other apps run on your willpower. useLess runs on your friends.

Reclaim 2+ hours every day. You try harder when your friends are watching.

Other apps give you a snooze button. useLess is different. Instead of white-knuckling it alone, your friends hold you accountable. When you get blocked and want more time, you'll have to ask them.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set rules for the apps you overuse: daily limits, focus schedules, whatever fits your life.
2. When a rule kicks in, the app blocks.
3. Need more time? Snap a photo explaining why, and send it to your friends.
4. Every request lands on the Walk of Shame, so your friends see exactly what you are begging for.

FEATURES

Ask a friend for time: When you are blocked, send a photo explaining why you need more time. Your friends keep you honest, and on stricter rules they decide if you get it.
Walk of Shame: Every request is visible to the friends you choose. Watch them beg for "just 5 more minutes" of TikTok, and let them watch you.
Weekly leaderboards: Compete on streaks, focus hours, and time spent on the apps that hook you.
Daily limits: Give each app a daily time budget that resets every morning.
Focus schedules: Block a set of apps
